Self-defined current economic status

(*) Unpaid family workers are included.

1- Employee (working full-time)
2- Employee (working part-time)
3- Self-employed (*) (working full-time)
4- Self-employed (*) (working part-time)
5- Looking for a job
6- Those who have been continuing their education/training
7- Retired or has given up business due to reasons related to age
8- Disabled and/or unable to work due to permanent health problems
9- Fulfilling domestic tasks and care responsibilities
10- Other inactive person

Has ever worked in a job or business to receive income in cash or in kind (for the ones who are not currently working)

[FI010>"4" and FI020="2"]
